catalogue.m2l: frame width — the odd one out
catalogue.note: The first screen of the whole set, and the only one at 1231 wide. One image arrived — state five of six, with the third section open — and it was measured and built on its own. The other five states were then written from it, which the flow layout makes cheap: opening a section pushes everything below it without a single position changing. The live version folds all six back into one full-height page with a working accordion, all three sections closed to start. The code pane here shows state five, the one that came from the picture.
